newsitem.title: FINLAND: UPM-Kymmene suspended on Helsinki bourse.
newsitem.headline: UPM-Kymmene suspended on Helsinki bourse.

text.p: Trade in shares of Finnish forest industry group UPM-Kymmene Oy was suspended on Tuesday on the Helsinki Stock Exchange at the company's own request, the bourse said in a statement.
The company said in a statement it will hold a news conference at 1200 (1000 GMT).

Before the suspension, UPM-Kymmene traded 1.70 markka higher at 95.70 markka. Early volume was a moderately active 68,630 shares. UPM-Kymmene's year-high price is 105.00 markka and the year-low 85.50 markka.
The news conference, about a significant corporate arrangement, will be held jointly with another Finnish forest industry group, Metsa-Serla Oy.
